review_type: Independent bounded W4 review of CI #42503 runtime-directory correction
binding: Official four-file audit input equals the frozen working files byte-for-byte. The retained successful preflight receipt names this commit; the native candidate receipt independently carries the identical recipe SHA256. No Git operation was used in this review.
scope: Runtime selection and group environment changes in conanfile.py plus matching manifest, notes and test report. Existing Qt source, patches and test assertions are reused without a new source review. Reviewer only read files and wrote this report; no HDC, UI, Git, build, test or recipe mutation.

correctness.root_cause: The actual CI built the product and selected tests, passed seven base programs, then failed 20 of 21 Wayland programs. Nineteen failures explicitly print AF_UNIX bind EPERM; reconnect also fails its display setup. The passing test intentionally exercises a failed connection.
correctness.upstream_behavior: QCOMPOSITOR_TEST_MAIN and several custom mains create QTemporaryDir and overwrite XDG_RUNTIME_DIR. Setting both TMPDIR and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR for the CTest process is necessary.
correctness.selection: Each group receives a new owned directory. The default temporary parent is tried first; OHOS adds /data/storage/el2/base/cache only as a candidate. A parent is selected after mode/ownership checks and real AF_UNIX bind/listen/connect/accept/data exchange succeed.
correctness.path_and_cleanup: The socket probe includes an extra qt_temp-* component and wayland-31 name, testing the additional path length used by upstream fixtures. Socket objects and nested directories use context managers; candidate/group cleanup is restricted to newly created directories.
correctness.E223_boundary: The fixed application-cache path is not assumed available across processes or devices. Creation, ownership, mode and socket behavior must succeed in the current execution context. An unusable cache is recorded and all-candidate failure remains fatal.
correctness.failure_propagation: Rejected candidates are retained with path/errno/error. When all candidates fail, the group records runtime_error without a successful exit code; the method still collects the other group and raises after saving results. Existing CTest failure remains fatal.
correctness.scoped_environment: TMPDIR/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and QPA mode apply only around each group command and are restored on exit. No global temporary-directory cache, parent permissions or external task directory is changed.

native_socket_probe.shared: bind errno 1; chmod leaves mode 02771 and synthetic owner 20001006
native_socket_probe.private_cache: owned mode 0700 and successful bind/listen/connect/accept/data transfer
native_socket_probe.scope: Observed in the tested application context; not a universal filesystem guarantee.

native_same_group_comparison.scope: Unchanged existing Wayland programs, same 60-second diagnostic timeout and selection on both sides; only the temporary-directory environment differs.

native_candidate_method.scope: The actual recipe method is loaded through the real Conan graph. Its run wrapper executes and records real subprocesses and preserves errors; it does not mock CTest. The unchanged production selections and 300-second timeout are used. Existing audited Qt binaries/kit support the run; this is not a new package build.

host_recipe_tests.failure_controls: First CTest group failure still runs the second group and remains fatal; both group environments restore and directories clean. All candidate socket failures produce recorded runtime_error and no CTest invocation.
host_recipe_tests.mock_scope: Windows lacks AF_UNIX in this interpreter. Host failure-flow tests mock only the socket probe; real socket behavior is established by the independent target runs.

documentation: The new four-file evidence consistently records 20/21 CI failures, the 19 explicit bind messages, the separate 21-program comparison and actual candidate 7+21 success. Twenty host checks are distinct from native program counts. Historical W3/full76/native110 identities and the 526/532 result remain separate; no new whole-recipe CI success is claimed.
limitations: Fresh complete CI build/package/consumer verification remains pending for this recipe commit.
Target validation uses the existing audited Qt binaries. Neither the native comparison nor the actual group-method run is represented as a new W3 or full 532-program run.
The worker must offer a candidate that satisfies ownership, mode and AF_UNIX checks. If neither candidate works, the recipe deliberately records a fatal failure.
Previous six full-suite failures and human C-candidate/task-mapping decisions remain outside this repair.
summary: Pass, with no P0/P1/P2/P3 finding in frozen commit 7855f42a09fd934f5d3ac6a058044b373b112748. The directory selector validates the current context and the group runner scopes both temporary-directory variables without changing upstream tests or failure status. Native shared/private comparison changes 20 failures to 21/21 passes; the exact candidate recipe method then passes 7+21 programs, restores the environment and cleans its directories. Host 20-test regression and full corrected-framework preflight pass. A new whole-recipe CI result remains pending.
